inputs.goal: investigate the S3 exfiltration alert; settle whether data left the account

leads: Identify the specific S3 bucket and objects that triggered the alert
Check CloudTrail logs for recent GET/COPY requests on the affected objects
Verify external IP addresses involved in these requests
Analyze any authorization mechanisms or access controls associated with the operations
